appearances.whereabouts: White Tower, Tar Valon - in various halls, a training room, the garden with the stone bridge
appearances.notable_actions: Follows the Accepted Pedra through the halls. Meets with Elayne who is assigned to help her. Demonstrates her ability to create a ball of light using saidar. Sees the glow around Elayne for the first time. Learns about Tower rules and the difficulties of novice life. Meets Min and Galad. Discusses Rand with multiple people. Flees to her chores when High sounds.
appearances.demeanor: curious, determined, independent, somewhat defensive about Rand, jealous when other girls show interest in him, initially angry at being treated as a child but beginning to accept the Tower's discipline

appearances.notable_actions: Wakes Egwene early, assigns her to sweep halls, tells her she must help wash dishes after dinner, escorts her to the training room where Elayne waits

appearances.whereabouts: White Tower - training room, then garden with stone bridge
appearances.notable_actions: Explains Tower life to Egwene. Demonstrates creating a ball of light and sees the glow around Egwene for the first time. Discusses Rand and his meetings with various people. Takes Egwene to meet Min. Interacts with Galad and Gawyn. Is reprimanded by Elaida for speaking to Aes Sedai unbidden. Runs to chores with Egwene when High sounds.
appearances.demeanor: friendly, helpful, dignified, determined, angry when publicly rebuked by Elaida but channeling that into determination to become Aes Sedai, disapproving of Galad

appearances.notable_actions: None in this chapter (only briefly mentioned)
appearances.demeanor: troubled, shadowed eyes, seems to have seen disturbing things in her Accepted test

appearances.notable_actions: Put Egwene's name in the novice book the previous evening. Is mentioned as the source of many Tower rules and theories about channeling.

Appears suddenly in a hallway where Egwene and Elayne are walking. Expresses bitterness about being watched constantly. Mentions wanting to walk and implies suicidal thoughts. Is led to the garden by an Accepted.
appearances.demeanor: sad, bitter, broken, shoulders sagging, laughing bitterly at his situation

appearances.whereabouts: Garden with stone bridge over a stream in the White Tower grounds
appearances.notable_actions: Sits cross-legged on the bridge wall. Banters with Elayne. Recognizes Egwene from Baerlon. Explains that she was summoned to Tar Valon by Aes Sedai. Discusses her ability to see auras and images around people. Sees things around Egwene (white flame and other things). Makes cryptic statements about what she sees. After Elaida interrogates her, goes in search of a place to cool off.
appearances.demeanor: friendly, wicked humor, independent, frustrated at being summoned and kept waiting by Moiraine, nervous after being questioned by Elaida

appearances.whereabouts: Garden, having come from sword practice
appearances.notable_actions: Approaches with Gawyn, both shirtless and carrying swords after practice. Bows over Egwene's hand. Asks to see Egwene again, suggests walking or picnicking. Bows to Elayne and addresses her as 'Sister.' Strolls away.
appearances.demeanor: graceful, focused intently on Egwene with his dark eyes, courteous but with an intensity that affects Egwene strongly

appearances.whereabouts: Garden, having come from sword practice
appearances.notable_actions: Arrives with Galad. Introduces himself when Egwene is too dazed by Galad to hear. Discusses Rand al'Thor and how Rand has shifted people's lives. Mentions meeting an old farmer who came to Caemlyn because of Rand. Suggests Rand might be ta'veren. Mentions Elaida's interest in Rand and her repeated questioning of him. Leaves when Elaida approaches to avoid a lecture about proper dress.
appearances.demeanor: good-humored, grinning, thoughtful, curious about Rand, friendly

appearances.whereabouts: White Tower garden with stone bridge
appearances.notable_actions: Crosses the garden wearing her red-fringed shawl. Reprimands Elayne for speaking to her familiarly, insisting that in the Tower Elayne is only a novice. Sends Egwene and Elayne away to their chores, commanding them to run. Orders Elayne to see the Mistress of Novices about speaking unbidden to Aes Sedai. Interrogates Min about being summoned by Moiraine and about Rand al'Thor.
appearances.demeanor: stern, hard, unreadable face, commanding, dispensing with pleasantries, focused on her purposes

appearances.notable_actions: Summoned Min to Tar Valon but has not yet revealed why
